data.summary: MusterFit Studios GmbH says the direct debit for your November 2025 membership fee was returned by your bank. It asks you to pay €47.40 (€39.90 plus a €7.50 reminder fee) by 12 December 2025.
data.explanation: Your gym tried to collect the November 2025 membership fee (€39.90) by direct debit, but your bank returned it. The gym now charges a €7.50 reminder fee (Mahngebühr) for the bank's returned-debit charge, so the total is €47.40. Pay this by 12 December 2025 and check that your account details are correct so future debits work. If you already paid, the letter says to treat it as settled. The letter doesn't state what happens if you don't pay.
